expected.subject: James, quick note from Legora
expected.body:
Hi James,

I saw you registered for our recent webinar but couldn't make it — completely understandable.

Legora is an AI contract review platform — firms use it to cut review time substantially without sacrificing accuracy.

If useful, grab a 25-minute walkthrough here: [CALENDLY_LINK].

William
Legora

notes: BAHR is a real Legora client so we skip the local-client reference to avoid being awkward. 180 lawyers = SMB+ tier.
